verdict.rationale: Nothing documents explicit bulk selection or batch actions. The evidence only implies operating on many items: rules (up to 1000) automate workflows across conversations, the API and an official MCP server let external AI act on conversations, and agents can triage new conversations or summarize the inbox. Missing for 10: documented multi-select or batch actions in the UI, bulk or batch API/MCP endpoints, limits and examples for mass updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
